implementationDecisions: Keep the user-selected English app name and focused Chinese app name.
Use subtitle space for photo/manual-review intent in English and skewer-use-case/manual-checking intent in Chinese; avoid repeating these words in the keyword field.
Replace broad inventory positioning with exposed skewer ends; remove unsupported general-object, reliable automated checkout, speed and accuracy guarantees.
First screenshot introduces the automatic reference area while explicitly requiring whole-photo review; second shows actual corrections and third genuine local history.
Keep one-time paid-download copy, no subscriptions or IAP, and no fixed currency amount in global descriptions. China CNY 12 remains a live pricing task.
